subject: literacy
concept: Understanding how cultural context shapes a literary work's themes and values
source_inspiration: original content, drawing on the Delight Engine's world-culture persona vault for authentic cultural framing — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student examines a short excerpt alongside brief factual cultural context and discusses how the context changes their reading
exercise.pictorial: Student matches a literary theme to the cultural context that likely shaped it
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a work's cultural origin influences its central themes or values

misconception_flags: interprets a text's values using only the reader's own cultural assumptions, ignoring the text's actual context

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
